calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_from) AS max_from
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT count(*) AS current_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_ids, count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) AS null_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_current_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31')<>1)) AS ids_without_exactly_one_open,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS last_sale
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current

WITH gold AS (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM gold) AS gold_enrolled, (SELECT count(*) FROM gold WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM act)) AS gold_active_52w
